COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
WPSS/1182/2026
Girish Chandra Singh
--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Bhagwat Mehta, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned 
Additional C.S.C. for the State of 
Uttarakhand. 
3. Mr. Rajendra Arya, Advocate holding 
brief of Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned counsel for 
the respondent-UPNL.
4. Petitioner is aggrieved by 
discontinuance of his engagement w.e.f. 
01.02.2026. Petitioner contends that he is 
serving continuously since 17.11.2014 on 
contract as Date Entry Operator in the Office 
of General Manager, District Industries 
Centre, Udham Singh Nagar and there is no 
valid reason for discontinuance of his 
engagement. 
5. Learned State Counsel, however, 
submits that since regular Personal Assistant 
and Junior Assistant, selected as per Rules, 
have joined duties, therefore, the service of 
contract employees are no more needed. He 
submits that contract employees have now 
become surplus. 6. Learned counsel for the petitioner, 
however, submits that work and post is still 
available and no appointment has been 
made on the post of Date Entry Operator.
7. Let counter affidavit be filed by the 
respondents within six weeks. 
8. List this case on 20.07.2026.
9. In the meantime, if work and post is 
available, then petitioner may be re-engaged 
on contract, as before. 
10. Interim relief application (IA No. 1 of 
2026) stands disposed of. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 05.05.2026
Aswal
